title: Docs Cloudflare and Alchemy Deployment Tasks
principles: Deliver one complete consumer/operator outcome in each vertical slice; do not build a horizontal infrastructure or governance platform first.
Upgrade Effect/Platform and Alchemy together to exact 4.0.0-beta.100 and 2.0.0-beta.64 pins in the first slice; do not propose beta.63 or latest.

Keep apps/docs responsible for build/runtime semantics, root alchemy.run.ts responsible for deployment composition, and tools/docs-deployment responsible for repository operations and provider readback.
Keep packages/docs-content and packages/docs-fumadocs deployment-neutral unless the real workerd proof demonstrates a request-time filesystem defect at one of their owned boundaries.
Preserve the current Nitro/Vercel built harness only as a temporary independent regression oracle and remove it after accepted Cloudflare parity.
Require exact candidate, state, plan, Worker, deployment/version, hosted behavior and screenshot identity without treating any local or visual proof as provider proof.
Use one new target-owned docs deployment runbook with distinct operation and authority sections; do not add a second runbook or duplicate procedures.

Keep Quality and tools/quality-workflow read-only and independently cancellable; deployment-only admission belongs under tools/docs-deployment and mutating stage locks are non-cancellable and stage-scoped.
Preserve HGI-203, HGI-206, HFI and completed docs-app history unchanged.

After grounding and before editing DCD-001, create one goal for the complete DCD-001 through DCD-005 implementation with no token budget, then create the active execution plan and keep the ledger tasks as milestones under that goal.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: The reviewed planning commit authorizes no implementation or provider operation. When DCD-001 implementation is separately authorized, the implementation thread must first create one goal covering DCD-001 through DCD-005, documentation reconciliation, independent review, verification and closeout, without a token budget; keep it active through authority stops and apply the goal tool's completion/blocking rules. Then create and route an active execution plan. Commit each coherent accepted slice only after its focused gates, task-local impact rows, primary-owner review, authority receipt where provider mutation occurred, and explicit no-Changeset decision. Any implementation, dependency, runtime, build, provider-config or candidate change invalidates the applicable workerd/Preview/Production/screenshot evidence. Push, versioning, tagging, package publication and custom-domain/DNS mutation remain separately authorized and outside this task list.
requiredBeforeFinalPR: focused execution of every task-created workerd, provider, screenshot, teardown and rollback command using the exact invocation backfilled by its owning task
fresh primary-owner review of final ownership, Effect shape, authority, proof, lifecycle, bridge retirement and no-Changeset rationale
evidenceRequired: Exact source commit, package manifest, lockfile, Alchemy source, compatibility-date and build-config identities
Exact Effect/Platform beta.100 and Alchemy beta.64 package integrity and peer-compatibility receipt
Local workerd receipt covering SSR, assets, server functions, 404, hydration, navigation, runtime reuse, filesystem absence, bundle/startup limits and console cleanliness
Preview plan digest, equal replan, Alchemy state and Cloudflare Worker/deployment/version readback, hosted proof, teardown or explicit stop receipt, and bounded desktop/mobile screenshot manifest
Production plan digest, accepted Preview source/config/dependency identity, provider readback, hosted proof, bounded desktop/mobile screenshot manifest and normal rollback/redeploy receipt
Workflow Schema/control receipts for exact SHA, stage locks, cancellation, protected environments, plan equality, PR-close teardown and report-only orphan inventory
Changed owners and final Change required, Preserve and N/A impact ledger
Limitations, non-claims, carrying costs, review triggers, retirement conditions and retained disconfirming evidence

downstreamArtifactImpact.acceptance: The proposed SPEC/tasks remain the sole current intent owner; an active plan is created only when DCD-001 starts and moves to completed history only after accepted closeout.

The root catalog and lock resolve the exact accepted beta.100/beta.64 graph; the docs manifest changes only for the real build/harness dependency or script proved by DCD-001. Other catalog-consuming manifests are preserved but proportionally qualified unless the upgrade proves a textual owner change.
The app owns one explicit Cloudflare build path, keeps route/React/ManagedRuntime boundaries intact, proves it under workerd and retires the Nitro bridge only after parity.

No deployment/provider responsibility enters either package; a change is permitted only after a retained workerd failure proves a request-time filesystem or generated-source defect at its existing owner.
Root composition owns one Cloudflare Website and remote state; tool-local Effect boundaries own plan, readback, receipts and provider operations without a new package, raw client or generic callback.
Alchemy, app deployment entries, generated Worker proof and temporary bridge outputs are reachable while stale Nitro/Vercel outputs are removed only in DCD-005.
Durable Cloudflare ownership, runtime, proof and future-domain boundaries are current; each materially revised legacy canonical document migrates to the current metadata contract.
Entry points route the verified local and operational commands after their owning tasks create them without copying runbook procedures.

Exactly five canonical runbooks are decoded and routed; one docs deployment runbook keeps state and app operations distinct, recovery links to it, and the changed TaxKit profile overlay receives a proportional successor epoch entry without rewriting retained prior epoch evidence.

Provider inventory, state bootstrap/adoption, Preview plan/deploy/destroy, Production plan/deploy, normal rollback, break-glass rollback and reconciliation have exact independent envelopes and unknown-stop defaults.
Three mutating classes and one report-only orphan inventory are Schema-admitted; exact-SHA, authority, stage locks, non-cancellation, digest equality, proof, recovery and retirement fail closed.
Quality retains contents:read, its current cancellation policy and canonical local release graph without provider credentials or deployment steps.

Exactly four supporting deployment claims and bounded dated receipts bind local workerd, Preview, Production, rollback and candidate-bound desktop/mobile screenshots without secret or raw-log retention.
Current local release journeys and immutable HGI/HFI/completed docs-app evidence retain their bytes, identities, limitations and non-claims.

Stages, resources, plan/readback/receipt identities and authority metadata decode through Schemas; credential values remain outside repository and receipts; no runtime secret or binding is added without evidence.
No domain, DNS, zone, certificate, route, Pages, application KV/D1/R2/Durable Object/Queue/Hyperdrive/Cron, Axiom, Sentry or observability destination exists in the initial resource graph.

Root Website composition explicitly enables only bounded built-in invocation logs with traces and sensitive fields absent after DCD-001 source/config qualification and DCD-002 provider readback, or records observability disabled until DCD-005 rather than inheriting an undocumented default.
No infrastructure package, generic provider framework or lint rule is added; a tool-local provider service exists only if direct readback proves a real substitution boundary.
Deployment work changes no public copy, navigation taxonomy, content lifecycle or publication decision.

The affected apps, root tooling and packages are private and this SPEC changes no public export or consumer package contract; each slice rechecks that fact and adds no Changeset unless implementation changes it.
